## 🚀 How to Get Listed

I want to recognize every meaningful contribution! If you have substantially contributed to the code, documentation, code review, or provided essential feedback and support, **you will be listed here**.

1. Make sure your contribution (e.g., Pull Request or Issue) has been **accepted and merged** into the project.
2. The list is updated on new releases. If your name is missing and you believe you should be included, open an [Issue](https://github.com/Magnetarman/WinToolkit/issues) and I will be happy to add you!
